CJ dos Santos.note: Santos is defined by sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
CJ dos Santos.noteZh: 他靠提前站位后的快速反应与同位置球员拉开差异。他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Dailon Livramento.note: Livramento stands out for waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Dailon Livramento.noteZh: 他的突出特点是等防守者注意力转移后再启动。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Deroy Duarte.note: Duarte's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Deroy Duarte.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防线重组前制造干净射门上。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Diney Borges.note: Diney stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Diney Borges.noteZh: 他的突出特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Garry Rodrigues.note: Rodrigues's edge is explosive speed once open grass appears. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Garry Rodrigues.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Gilson Benchimol.note: Benchimol stands out for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Gilson Benchimol.noteZh: 他的突出特点是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Helio Varela.note: Varela's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Helio Varela.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防线重组前制造干净射门上。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Jamiro Monteiro.note: Monteiro's signature is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Jamiro Monteiro.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定上。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

João Paulo.note: Paulo's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
João Paulo.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Jovane Cabral.note: Cabral's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Jovane Cabral.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在变向时仍把球控制在脚下上。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Kelvin Pires.note: Pires is defined by making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Kelvin Pires.noteZh: 他靠在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Kevin Pina.note: Watch Pina for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Kevin Pina.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防线重组前制造干净射门。留意他如何守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Laros Duarte.note: Duarte stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Laros Duarte.noteZh: 他的突出特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Logan Costa.note: Costa's edge is recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Logan Costa.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Marcio Rosa.note: Rosa's signature is staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Marcio Rosa.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注上。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Nuno da Costa.note: Watch Costa for making the next teammate's action easier. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Nuno da Costa.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是让队友下一步处理更轻松。留意他如何从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Roberto Lopes.note: Lopes stands out for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Roberto Lopes.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在危险出现前组织好队友。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Ryan Mendes.note: Mendes's signature is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Ryan Mendes.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在比防线早一步看到决定性的传球上。他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Sidny Lopes Cabral.note: Cabral's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Sidny Lopes Cabral.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防线重组前制造干净射门上。他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Steven Moreira.note: Moreira stands out for calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Steven Moreira.noteZh: 他的突出特点是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Stopira.summary: Stopira is a Cabo Verde centre-back from SC União Torreense who gives the national team veteran defending, left-footed balance, and set-piece toughness.
Stopira.note: Stopira's signature is calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Stopira.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断上。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Telmo Arcanjo.note: Arcanjo's signature is creating a better angle for the next pass. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Telmo Arcanjo.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在为下一脚传球制造更好的角度上。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Vozinha.summary: Vozinha is a Cabo Verde goalkeeper from Chaves who gives the national team veteran command, shot stopping, and tournament experience.
Vozinha.note: Watch Vozinha for calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Vozinha.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。留意他如何在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Wagner Pina.note: Pina stands out for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Wagner Pina.noteZh: 他的突出特点是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Willy Semedo.note: Watch Semedo for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Willy Semedo.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。留意他如何从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Yannick Semedo.note: Watch Semedo for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Yannick Semedo.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。留意他如何出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。
